map.能按行重复吗？: Can It Repeat Line by Line?
map.可设「整段重复 N 次」或「每行重复」，区别在是否换行；做分隔线用单行重复，做列: You can choose "repeat the whole block N times" or "repeat each line"; the difference is whether a line break is inserted. Use single-line repeat for separators and per-line repeat for lists.
